messages:
anna_ml: Heads-up — ran the prefetched prefix + continuous-batcher test matrix on the new AWQ FP8 build and found a repeatable quality dip vs the GPTQ INT8 baseline.

mohit: numbers?

anna_ml: Short summary: exact-match -1.4% (on our QA eval set), Rouge-L -0.9, avg latency +7ms, p95 latency +20ms, throughput +5% (more batching). Token-level logprob shift visible on middle tokens.

anna_ml: Repro steps: enable prefix_prefetch=true, continuous_batching=true, batch_window_ms=18, quant=awq-fp8, model=redwood-13b-v2.

anna_ml: Config snippet:
```
prefetch: true
prefetch_ttl_ms: 12000
continuous_batching: true
batch_window_ms: 18
quant_profile: awq_fp8_opt
```

mohit: Interesting that throughput improves but EM drops. Could be quantization interacting with KV cache indices or prefetch staleness.

julia: Can you paste the eval harness command? I'll run locally.

anna_ml: `./eval_harness --model redwood-13b-v2 --quant awq_fp8_opt --eval-set prod-qa-1000 --prefetch true --batch-window 18 --continuous`

perf-bot: Automated run results (1799802460-run-12): EM: 0.860 -> 0.846, Rouge-L: 0.732 -> 0.723, p95 latency 98ms -> 118ms, throughput 120 req/s -> 126 req/s. CSV attached to run artifact. :gear:

kevin_ops: SLO-check — p95 jumped above our soft threshold for that route, slo-bot already fired.

slo-bot: SLO alert: route /chat/model-redwood-13b-v2 p95 latency = 118ms (threshold 100ms). Triggered at 2026-10-12T14:02:40Z.

luis: Hypothesis: AWQ FP8 changes small-value dynamics; when prefix prefetch returns cached KV segments, the combination with continuous batching (variable KV placement) can cause subtle alignment shifts in KV indices leading to slightly different self-attention keys for medium-length contexts. That could flip logits on ambiguous tokens.

mohit: Agreed. Two hypotheses: 1) quant noise interacting with cache prefetch ordering; 2) different micro-batching pad/packing causing position id offsets when cache is reused.

julia: Quick repro plan: 1) run eval with prefetch=true/false on AWQ and GPTQ; 2) instrument `kv_idx_version`, `prefetch_hit`, `batch_pack_map` per request; 3) compare token-level KL and top-3 token changes. I'll assemble the script.

anna_ml: Logging exposed: `prefetch_hit_rate=0.87`, `kv_idx_version` toggled between 2 & 3 across requests, `batch_pack_map` shows some requests got packed into older KV slices.

luis: If kv_idx_version isn't pinned to quant variant + compile hash, cache reuse across compile variants could be invalid. Maybe prefetch TTL too long relative to version churn.

kevin_ops: Operational quick wins: shorten prefetch_ttl_ms to 3000 for AWQ builds; set continuous_batching.batch_align=false (force batch boundary alignment) and re-run. If SLOs improve we can A/B.

mohit: Also try `force_kv_version_pin=true` in runtime to prevent cross-variant reuse. If that removes the EM delta, it's a strong signal.

julia: I'll kick off three jobs: (A) AWQ FP8 pref=true cont=true (baseline reproduce), (B) AWQ pref=false cont=true, (C) AWQ pref=true cont=true but `force_kv_version_pin=true`. Each on eval set prod-qa-1000, 1k samples.

anna_ml: Added instrumentation checklist: log per-token top-5 diff, store seeds, record `kv_idx_version`, `compile_hash`, `prefetch_ttl_ms`, `batch_window_ms`, and whether request hit prefix cache.

perf-bot: Queued jobs A/B/C. Expect artifacts in ~45m.

luis: If A vs C shows EM restored in C, we think cache index pinning is the fix; possible follow-ups: pin by (quant_profile, compile_hash) or invalidate prefetch on compile change.

kevin_ops: If we short-term shorten TTL and pin KV in parallel, roll both to canary for the dedicated fleet only. Watch cost impact (more misses).

mohit: Good. Also create an eval that compares AWQ-FP8 vs GPTQ-INT8 with identical batching semantics (explicitly disable continuous batching) to separate quant effects from batching effects.

anna_ml: Will post results when perf-bot finishes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
